scriptLines: department = case(     in(['onco', 'oncology', 'oncologyy'], lower(trim(department))), 'Oncology',     in(['cardio', 'cardiology', 'cardiolgy'], lower(trim(department))), 'Cardiology',     in(['neuro', 'neurology', 'nuerology'], lower(trim(department))), 'Neurology',     in(['er', 'emergency', 'emergancy'], lower(trim(department))), 'Emergency',     in(['gen surg', 'general surgery', 'generalsurgery'], lower(trim(department))), 'General Surgery',     in(['peds', 'pediatrics', 'paediatrics'], lower(trim(department))), 'Pediatrics',     in(['ortho', 'orthopedics', 'orthopaedics'], lower(trim(department))), 'Orthopedics',     initCap(trim(department)) )) ~> derivedColumn1

derivedColumn1 derive(admission_date = coalesce(     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd/MM/yyyy'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),     toDate(substring(trim(admission_date), 1, 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd') ),

discharge_date = coalesce(     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy', 'en-US'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US') )) ~> derivedColumn2

derivedColumn2 derive(admission_date = iif(     !isNull(admission_date) && !isNull(discharge_date) && discharge_date < admission_date,     discharge_date,     coalesce(admission_date, discharge_date) ),
discharge_date = iif(     !isNull(admission_date) && !isNull(discharge_date) && discharge_date < admission_date,     admission_date,     discharge_date )) ~> derivedColumn3
